name: orientdb
description: OrientDB is the most versatile DBMS supporting Graph, Document, Reactive, Full-Text and Geospatial models in one Multi-Model product. OrientDB can run distributed (Multi-Master), supports SQL, ACID Transactions, Full-Text indexing and Reactive Queries.

latest_release.body:
This patch release saw fixes is multiple areas done by multiple contributors, in the specific fixes in `LIKE` operator and remote spatial done by @mvanhorn, fixes in use of  spatial index in functions done by @sblommers, the rest done by the maintainers, following the list of changes

# Changes 


## Core
- Fix like operator to match in the wildcard also new line terminators #10895

## Lucene
- Use spacial index in equality operations, issue #10893

## Remote
- Avoid to encode document to spatial types in remote client, issue #10929

## Distributed 
- Make sure to drop cached sync backup in case of error like out of disk space, issue #10987
